parse: (: keeper_believe_rule (Implication (Member $k keeper) (And (Member (sk_believe $k) believe) (Experiencer (sk_believe $k) $k) (Theme (sk_believe $k) (And (Possession sk_group_1 sk_storm_surge_1) (Member sk_become_1 become) (Patient sk_become_1 sk_group_1) (Past sk_become_1) (Member sk_wraith_1 wraith) (Experiencer sk_wraith_1 sk_group_1) (Result sk_become_1 sk_wraith_1) (Implication (PartOf $x sk_group_1) (Member $x wraith)))))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q2_gaps: A 'casualties / victims of <event>' of-phrase ('the dead of the storm-surge'): it is not a part-whole, not a genuine possessive, not a partitive (no cardinal or proportional amount, and the dead are not members of the surge), and not a nominalization's object of-phrase (no underlying verb takes the surge as its object), so the instruction set licenses no head for the relation — the parse falls back on the opaque Possession, which the of-phrase rules neither license nor bar for this case.
review.notes: Seal projection follows the interim table exactly — the definite GroupOf/Member typing and the storm_surge genus project to top level while the of-link, the become/Result bundle, its Past and the per-member distribution rule all stay sealed — and the sealed rule's variable ($x) is fresh against the matrix rule's ($k). The change-of-kind 'became' takes the mandated Patient-subject + reified-state + Result shape with the flat half correctly replaced by the plural-group per-member rule.
